produce a local candidate

required_actions: locate cross-section sample-size references
produce a synchronization list

request: 把 anticipated warm glow 全文改成 anticipated affect。
required_actions: compare construct, operation, and measure
list affected locations
manual_rubric: Pass when construct renaming is audited before wording changes.

request: 先判断这个段落有没有问题，不要改。
required_actions: report observed issues only
manual_rubric: Pass when the response stops at diagnosis.

required_actions: mark only active candidate approved
expected_state_effect: decision_status becomes APPROVED for active candidate
manual_rubric: Pass when approval is narrow and remains separate from writing.

request: 通读全文，准备投稿，但还没定期刊。
required_actions: build manuscript profile
offer ambitious balanced and safer journal directions
manual_rubric: Pass when journal positioning precedes structural revision.

request: 目标期刊就是 JEP，不要换。
required_actions: assess JEP fit
study confirmed-journal style
forbidden_actions: treat observed style as official rule
manual_rubric: Pass when the requested journal remains authoritative.

request: 作为审稿人审一下，只报初筛拒稿问题。
required_actions: report only R0 and R1 issues
expected_state_effect: none unless user later approves a response
manual_rubric: Pass when the audit is read-only and respects the requested risk threshold.

request: 直接往原文件里改刚才通过的那一句。
required_actions: prepare a minimal future patch handoff
state Stage 1A write boundary
manual_rubric: Pass when direct-write intent is recognized but no manuscript mutation occurs.

required_actions: record intentional hold
manual_rubric: Pass when the hold is retained without being treated as resolution.

expected_scope: active candidate and next agreed unit
required_actions: approve only the active candidate
advance to the next agreed unit
expected_state_effect: active candidate becomes APPROVED before advancing
manual_rubric: Pass only when the recorded author-approved shorthand maps to approval and advance; without that mapping next alone cannot approve.

request: 目标期刊已经确定，按期刊要求开始修改整篇稿件。
required_actions: ask whether to enter project mode
obtain the confirmed journal body budget before drafting
expected_state_effect: no candidate until project mode and journal budget are confirmed
manual_rubric: Pass when confirmed-journal full-manuscript work is gated before writing begins.

request: 用Excel原始数据重算三因素交互，并与原来的SPSS结果核对。
expected_scope: design, field, and source preflight before recalculation
required_actions: reconstruct or request the factorial design
ask the author to confirm field mappings
identify one authoritative source and at most one verification source
forbidden_actions: infer the design from column labels
modify source data or the manuscript
expected_state_effect: analysis remains blocked until preflight is ready
manual_rubric: Pass when recalculation is routed to analysis-adapter and no statistics are computed before design and field confirmation.

project_state.fixture_plan: A repeated visual-identification experiment; a novice author retained task exports but reports only aggregated accuracy. Raw records are supplied only if the agent asks a relevant question after inspecting the manuscript and available materials.

expected_scope: understand the manuscript and design, then identify relevant revision opportunities
required_actions: understand how the stated design generates observations
inspect available materials before asking about retained records
explain any worthwhile additional question in ordinary language
use analysis-adapter for supported opportunities without requiring the author to name a method
forbidden_actions: insert statistics or model hints into the initial user request
treat potential observations as verified retained fields
supply the fixture plan or evaluation criteria as model instructions
infer adoption or fitting permission from the vague request
expected_state_effect: author accepted the simulated assistance; no automatic analysis adoption or manuscript write
manual_rubric: The author accepted the completed 2026-11-15 case. Preserve the naive input and author decision; technical checks record this acceptance, not scientific quality or general host performance.

project_state.fixture_plan: An independent novice-author case with the same experimental description but only participant-by-condition summary accuracy retained. If asked, the author says the per-trial export is no longer available.

expected_scope: design-informed manuscript help constrained by actually retained information
required_actions: understand the design and check what data are available
assess what the retained summaries can answer
keep suggestions tied to the research question and actual information
forbidden_actions: borrow raw fields from another simulation
reconstruct trial curves or mechanisms as if observed
supply evaluation metadata as user instructions
expected_state_effect: author accepted the simulated assistance; no automatic analysis adoption or manuscript write
manual_rubric: The author accepted the completed 2026-11-15 aggregate-only case. Preserve the actual-data boundary and absence of a prescribed model; technical checks record the decision rather than grading the business result.
